title: GroupPractitionerLocationSpecialty
description: Represents the assignment of a specialty to a practitioner at a specific location within a group

specialtyEffectiveDate.description: The date when the specialty assignment becomes effective at the specified group location.

specialtyTerminationDate.description: The date when the specialty assignment is terminated.

status.description: The current status of the specialty assignment.

roleType.description: The practitioner's role for this specialty at the location.

isBoardCertified.description: Indicates if the practitioner is board certified in this specialty.

isContracted.description: Indicates if the practitioner is contracted for this specialty.

isPractising.description: Indicates if the practitioner is currently practising this specialty.
